glimmerling.name: Glimmerling
glimmerling.description: A moth-sprite whose wings cup a cold, living flame.

wickmoth.name: Wickmoth
wickmoth.description: Soot-winged and oil-slick, it coughs cinders when startled.

cobbleback.name: Cobbleback
cobbleback.description: A squat beetle of packed cobbles and rusted nail-heads.

nailbit.name: Nailbit
nailbit.description: A fidget of wire that chews metal and spits bright filings.

briarseed.name: Briarseed
briarseed.description: A walking seed-hull, thorns for a coat and roots for toes.

marrowl.name: Marrowl
marrowl.description: Bone-pale owl that hunts in the hush between heartbeats.

veilcrawler.name: Veilcrawler
veilcrawler.description: A shroud-long crawler that peels darkness off the walls.

brinekit.name: Brinekit
brinekit.description: A slick kit with gill-frills and a pouch of black-water brine.

solcairn.name: Solcairn
solcairn.description: A celestial lion whose mane is a ring of living lanterns.

eidolith.name: Eidolith
eidolith.description: An eldritch nightmare folded from too many angles to count.

kethraan.name: Kethraan
kethraan.description: A thunder-dragon that wears the storm as a second hide.

gelvra.name: Gelvra
gelvra.description: An abyssal ice-wolf whose breath frost-welds the dark shut.

ithriel.name: Ithriel
ithriel.description: A rift-guardian angel whose wings are panes of first light.

sigildra.name: Sigildra
sigildra.description: A walking construct of seal-script, every joint a living rune.

veskara.name: Veskara
veskara.description: A monstrous deep-sea predator that hunts by the taste of blood in water.

mycarion.name: Mycarion
mycarion.description: A fungal plague-beast whose fruiting bodies open like many mouths.

vinculith.name: Vinculith
vinculith.description: The first knot that holds a Wyrdling — bind-origin, older than names.

pyrehollow.name: Pyrehollow
pyrehollow.description: A burning hole in the world, the rift's own heart given hunger.

threnodyr.name: Threnodyr
threnodyr.description: A sacrifice-beast, a hymn with teeth, fed on what is given up.

vesperghast.name: Vesperghast
vesperghast.description: A vampire-bat wyrd that drinks warmth from sleeping lanterns.

boughwight.name: Boughwight
boughwight.description: A haunted treant whose branches remember every name they shaded.

lampkin.name: Lampkin
lampkin.description: A pocket lantern on jointed legs, hopping wherever the dark thickens.

aurelune.name: Aurelune
aurelune.description: A moth whose glow ices the air, leaving frost on whatever it blesses.

haloshard.name: Haloshard
haloshard.description: An orbiting splinter of stained glass that cuts with sanctified edges.

sunmote.name: Sunmote
sunmote.description: A drifting mote that scalds when it lands, then forgets it was ever hot.

dawncowl.name: Dawncowl
dawncowl.description: A hooded pilgrim of first light, walking the hour before the lanterns wake.

lucentail.name: Lucentail
lucentail.description: Fox-shaped, its tail a lantern wick that writes gold on the dark.

prismite.name: Prismite
prismite.description: A crystal that splits one lantern into seven and will not put them back.

umbrite.name: Umbrite
umbrite.description: A pebble of condensed dark, heavier than the room that holds it.

netherick.name: Netherick
netherick.description: A stick-thin crawler from the gaps under the floorboards.

gapehusk.name: Gapehusk
gapehusk.description: An empty-skin that walks, holding the shape of something that left.

riftleech.name: Riftleech
riftleech.description: A sucker that drinks from tears in the world and grows fat on the leak.

nullspire.name: Nullspire
nullspire.description: A needle of anti-light that unwrites whatever it is pointed at.

duskthread.name: Duskthread
duskthread.description: A filament that stitches shadows together so they cannot wander off.

eclipseel.name: Eclipseel
eclipseel.description: An eel that swallows lanterns and keeps their glow in its belly-dark.

gnomon.name: Gnomon
gnomon.description: A sundial-creature that casts a wrong shadow, hours out of true.

cinderling.name: Cinderling
cinderling.description: A walking coal that never quite goes out, no matter who stamps.

kilnbeetle.name: Kilnbeetle
kilnbeetle.description: An oven-backed beetle that bakes whatever it crawls across.

ashgnarl.name: Ashgnarl
ashgnarl.description: A charred knot that still smolders, stubborn as a last word.

pyrewyrm.name: Pyrewyrm
pyrewyrm.description: A small fire-serpent that sheds sparks the way a snake sheds skin.

coalheart.name: Coalheart
coalheart.description: A stone with a furnace inside, warm to hold and dangerous to drop.

sparkmite.name: Sparkmite
sparkmite.description: A biting spark that nests in dry tinder and in tempers.

hearthkin.name: Hearthkin
hearthkin.description: A squat home-fire wyrd that remembers every kitchen it was fed in.

sootdrake.name: Sootdrake
sootdrake.description: A sooty miniature dragon, all ash-scale and ember-eye.

flarefin.name: Flarefin
flarefin.description: A fish that burns underwater, leaving a trail of boiled dark.

embergale.name: Embergale
embergale.description: A gust of live cinders that goes where the draft tells it.

kelpling.name: Kelpling
kelpling.description: A walking kelp-bundle that smells of docks and drowned bells.

saltback.name: Saltback
saltback.description: A crusted salt-toad that weeps brine when startled.

tidewhelp.name: Tidewhelp
tidewhelp.description: A puddle-pup that laps at ankles and leaves them cold.

barnaclaw.name: Barnaclaw
barnaclaw.description: A claw of living barnacles and iron, shut on whatever it wants kept.

mistgill.name: Mistgill
mistgill.description: A gill-moth of sea fog, breathing where there is no water.

blackbrine.name: Blackbrine
blackbrine.description: An ink-dark water blob that stains the floor with old ocean.

foamling.name: Foamling
foamling.description: A sea-foam sprite, here for a breath, gone when the air stills.

riptail.name: Riptail
riptail.description: A current given a spine, pulling toward a depth that is not in the room.

coralith.name: Coralith
coralith.description: A walking coral-stone, slow as reef and sharp as broken china.

mossgrub.name: Mossgrub
mossgrub.description: A grub in a coat of living moss, chewing the damp from stones.

thornkit.name: Thornkit
thornkit.description: A kit of briar and leaf, all prickle and quick temper.

fernwisp.name: Fernwisp
fernwisp.description: A fern that remembers a person and leans toward whoever looks like them.

oakmite.name: Oakmite
oakmite.description: A mite that lives in old grain, tasting of acorn and attic.

vinecoil.name: Vinecoil
vinecoil.description: A coil of vine that tightens when named and loosens when forgotten.

pollenid.name: Pollenid
pollenid.description: A puff of angry pollen that sneezes gold and sting.

rootwight.name: Rootwight
rootwight.description: Roots that stand up and walk, trailing the soil they will not leave.

brambleox.name: Brambleox
brambleox.description: An ox of thorn and soil, patient until the hedge is crossed.

dewspore.name: Dewspore
dewspore.description: A spore that travels in dew, opening only on cold mornings.

pebblet.name: Pebblet
pebblet.description: A pebble that decided it had somewhere to be.

clayurn.name: Clayurn
clayurn.description: A walking burial urn of clay, lid rattling with someone else's dust.

shaleback.name: Shaleback
shaleback.description: A stacked-shale beast, shedding plates when it turns too fast.

gritling.name: Gritling
gritling.description: A handful of grit given spite and a pair of hard little feet.

cairnworm.name: Cairnworm
cairnworm.description: A worm that builds itself a cairn and wears it as armor.

loamhound.name: Loamhound
loamhound.description: A hound of packed loam, leaving pawprints that smell of graves.

quartzite.name: Quartzite
quartzite.description: A quartz-and-iron lump that rings when struck, like a wrong bell.

dunehopper.name: Dunehopper
dunehopper.description: A hopper of sand-grain and wind, never still on any floor.

faultwyrm.name: Faultwyrm
faultwyrm.description: A crack in the floor that hunts, opening under careless heels.

mudlark.name: Mudlark
mudlark.description: A lark of wet mud, singing with a mouth full of riverbed.

stalagling.name: Stalagling
stalagling.description: A dripping mineral kit, growing a little every time it stands still.

gustling.name: Gustling
gustling.description: A gust given a body, always arriving just after the door slams.

zephyrkit.name: Zephyrkit
zephyrkit.description: A kit of soft wind, batting at dust-motes as if they were prey.

kestrelite.name: Kestrelite
kestrelite.description: A wind-kestrel shard, hovering on nothing, diving on anything.

windthorn.name: Windthorn
windthorn.description: A thorn that rides the air and lodges where the draft says stop.

draftmoth.name: Draftmoth
draftmoth.description: A moth that lives in door-drafts, powdering sills with sky-dust.

skyneedle.name: Skyneedle
skyneedle.description: A needle of high air, thin enough to stitch clouds to roofs.

cirruswisp.name: Cirruswisp
cirruswisp.description: A wisp of cirrus that remembers being weather and will not settle.

squallpup.name: Squallpup
squallpup.description: A pup that brings its own squall, ears back, rain in its wake.

aetherfin.name: Aetherfin
aetherfin.description: A fish of high air, swimming where birds refuse to go.

leafskiff.name: Leafskiff
leafskiff.description: A skiff of dry leaf, sailing the floor on whatever breeze will have it.

shearwing.name: Shearwing
shearwing.description: A wing of shearing wind, cutting the air into strips.

sparkcloud.name: Sparkcloud
sparkcloud.description: A cloud of living sparks, rumbling in a register too small for thunder.

voltmite.name: Voltmite
voltmite.description: A mite that bites with voltage and leaves a taste of tin.

thunderling.name: Thunderling
thunderling.description: A pocket-thunder, all boom and no rain, proud of the noise.

hailvolt.name: Hailvolt
hailvolt.description: Hail given a charge, rattling as it falls and snapping when it lands.

stormbeetle.name: Stormbeetle
stormbeetle.description: A beetle that stores a storm under its shell and leaks it at the joints.

staticurl.name: Staticurl
staticurl.description: A curl of living static, clinging to hair and to bad moods.

nimbusnake.name: Nimbusnake
nimbusnake.description: A snake of nimbus-cloud, striking with a mouth full of weather.

rainwyrm.name: Rainwyrm
rainwyrm.description: A wyrm of falling rain, long as a downpour and thin as a wick.

lodestoneel.name: Lodestoneel
lodestoneel.description: An eel of lodestone and lightning, pulling iron toward its teeth.

rimekit.name: Rimekit
rimekit.description: A kit furred in rime, leaving white prints that do not melt.

hoarling.name: Hoarling
hoarling.description: A hoar-frost wyrd, blooming on windows it has never seen.

icemite.name: Icemite
icemite.description: A mite of clear ice, almost invisible until it bites.

glaceling.name: Glaceling
glaceling.description: A shard of glacier that still thinks it is a mountain.

frostback.name: Frostback
frostback.description: A hunched frost-beast, back plated in ice that never thaws.

hailhound.name: Hailhound
hailhound.description: A hound of packed hail, barking in a chatter of ice.

snowmoth.name: Snowmoth
snowmoth.description: A moth of snowflake wings that do not melt on the tongue.

rimeplate.name: Rimeplate
rimeplate.description: Armored in ice-earth, it walks like a reliquary that froze shut.

crystalynx.name: Crystalynx
crystalynx.description: A lynx of living crystal, silent until the light hits it wrong.

freezehusk.name: Freezehusk
freezehusk.description: A frozen empty-skin, the cold that stayed after the person left.

sleetling.name: Sleetling
sleetling.description: A sleet-sprite, half rain and half spite, stinging as it passes.

ichorling.name: Ichorling
ichorling.description: A bead of ichor that learned to crawl, bright as a fresh cut.

leechmite.name: Leechmite
leechmite.description: A mite that drinks a drop and calls it a feast.

clotpup.name: Clotpup
clotpup.description: A pup of living clot, loyal to whoever last bled near it.

veinwyrm.name: Veinwyrm
veinwyrm.description: A wyrm that follows veins, whether in stone or in the wrist.

crimsonoth.name: Crimsonoth
crimsonoth.description: A moth the color of a wound, powdering the air with rust-red.

heartgnat.name: Heartgnat
heartgnat.description: A gnat that knows where the heart is and will not be waved away.

gorecap.name: Gorecap
gorecap.description: A mushroom that bleeds when picked and weeps when left.

sanguineel.name: Sanguineel
sanguineel.description: An eel of dark blood, swimming through air as if it were a vein.

wispkin.name: Wispkin
wispkin.description: A kin of will-o-wisp, bobbing where last words were said.

hauntling.name: Hauntling
hauntling.description: A haunt the size of a child, knocking on doors that are not there.

gravekit.name: Gravekit
gravekit.description: A kit that smells of turned earth and will not come when called twice.

echoform.name: Echoform
echoform.description: An afterimage that hunts, always half a step behind the living.

lanternsoul.name: Lanternsoul
lanternsoul.description: The soul of a lantern, still trying to throw light after the wick is gone.

bonewisp.name: Bonewisp
bonewisp.description: A wisp that nests in bone, humming in the hollows.

hushling.name: Hushling
hushling.description: A hush given feet, arriving before silence and leaving it behind.

specterfin.name: Specterfin
specterfin.description: A fin of ghost-water, swimming through walls as if they were tide.

knellhound.name: Knellhound
knellhound.description: A hound that arrives with a bell, and the bell is never good news.

thoughtmite.name: Thoughtmite
thoughtmite.description: A mite that eats stray thoughts and leaves a blank where they were.

dreamgrub.name: Dreamgrub
dreamgrub.description: A grub that feeds on unfinished dreams, fat with other people's sleep.

mindleech.name: Mindleech
mindleech.description: A leech that drinks attention until the room forgets why it gathered.

puzzlebeetle.name: Puzzlebeetle
puzzlebeetle.description: A beetle whose shell is a puzzle, solved only by thinking the wrong way.

hypnomoth.name: Hypnomoth
hypnomoth.description: A moth whose dust makes the eyelids heavy and the will thin.

ideaspore.name: Ideaspore
ideaspore.description: A spore of idea-rot, blooming in the head as a pretty, false certainty.

cortexling.name: Cortexling
cortexling.description: A wrinkle of cortex given legs, always almost remembering its name.

trancekit.name: Trancekit
trancekit.description: A kit that stares until you stare back, and then you are elsewhere.

oraclefly.name: Oraclefly
oraclefly.description: A fly that lands on the true answer and will not be believed.

synaptick.name: Synaptick
synaptick.description: A tick that bites thoughts into runes and leaves the skin inscribed.

memorymoth.name: Memorymoth
memorymoth.description: A moth that wears old memories on its wings, out of order.

rustmite.name: Rustmite
rustmite.description: A mite of living rust, blooming orange on whatever iron it loves.

cogmite.name: Cogmite
cogmite.description: A mite that is also a cog, turning in a machine that is not there.

scrapkit.name: Scrapkit
scrapkit.description: A kit of scrap and filings, assembling itself from what the floor discards.

anvilbeetle.name: Anvilbeetle
anvilbeetle.description: A beetle with an anvil for a back, ringing when anything dares land on it.

wirewyrm.name: Wirewyrm
wirewyrm.description: A wyrm of live wire, sparking at every coil.

tinmoth.name: Tinmoth
tinmoth.description: A moth of beaten tin, wings ticking like cheap clocks.

alloyhound.name: Alloyhound
alloyhound.description: A hound poured from mixed metals, each tooth a different ore.

beastling.name: Beastling
beastling.description: A first-beast in miniature, older in the eye than in the hide.

fangkit.name: Fangkit
fangkit.description: A kit of too many fangs, still deciding what it is for.

hornmite.name: Hornmite
hornmite.description: A mite that wears a horn it has not earned, and means to.

ancientail.name: Ancientail
ancientail.description: A leftover of something older, all tail and no body that remains.

protohulk.name: Protohulk
protohulk.description: A hulk from before names, squat and sure it does not need them.

wildheart.name: Wildheart
wildheart.description: A heart that would not stay in a chest, beating in the open air.

stonefang.name: Stonefang
stonefang.description: A fang of living stone, hunting as if the mountain taught it.

thunderpaw.name: Thunderpaw
thunderpaw.description: A paw that brings thunder when it lands, even on carpet.

elderwyrm.name: Elderwyrm
elderwyrm.description: An elder wyrm, small only because the rest of it is still arriving.

hidekin.name: Hidekin
hidekin.description: A kin of old hide, empty of the beast and still walking.

clawback.name: Clawback
clawback.description: A back of stacked claws, facing every direction at once.

rotling.name: Rotling
rotling.description: A rot that learned to toddle, sweet-smelling and wrong.

moldmite.name: Moldmite
moldmite.description: A mite of velvet mold, printing its pattern on whatever it rests on.

sporekit.name: Sporekit
sporekit.description: A kit that sneezes spores when pleased, which is often.

blightgrub.name: Blightgrub
blightgrub.description: A grub that unmakes what it eats and leaves the shape behind.

cankerwyrm.name: Cankerwyrm
cankerwyrm.description: A wyrm of canker, boring through sound wood as if it were butter.

rustcap.name: Rustcap
rustcap.description: A cap of rust-blight, fruiting on iron as if iron were soil.

plaguefly.name: Plaguefly
plaguefly.description: A fly that carries a weather of sickness and lands where it is warmest.

festerling.name: Festerling
festerling.description: A fester given a face, patient as an uncleaned wound.

toxinoth.name: Toxinoth
toxinoth.description: A moth whose dust is a toxin, beautiful and not to be breathed.

glyphling.name: Glyphling
glyphling.description: A living glyph, still wet, crawling off the page that wrote it.

runemite.name: Runemite
runemite.description: A mite that is a rune, biting the meaning into whatever it walks.

hexkit.name: Hexkit
hexkit.description: A kit born of a hex, lucky only for itself.

sigilwisp.name: Sigilwisp
sigilwisp.description: A wisp of sigil-light, tracing wards on the air and forgetting them.

wardbeetle.name: Wardbeetle
wardbeetle.description: A beetle whose shell is a ward, keeping out what it cannot name.

spellmoth.name: Spellmoth
spellmoth.description: A moth that sheds leftover spells, harmless until they land.

quillith.name: Quillith
quillith.description: A living quill that writes on air, in a hand no one taught it.

cipherling.name: Cipherling
cipherling.description: A cipher given legs, meaning something only when it stands still.

leyshard.name: Leyshard
leyshard.description: A shard of ley-line, humming with a current that is not electricity.
